title: Co-FunSearch finds adversarial instances raising the Best-Fit bin packing bound
summary: A human-LLM pipeline (Co-FunSearch) finds adversarial instances for heuristics, raising the lower bound for Best-Fit bin packing in the random-order model from 1.3 to 1.5. The authors prove the 3/2 ratio analytically and report a search-found instance scoring 1.497 over 10,000 random shuffles against Packingsolver optima. Caveat: arXiv preprint; human analysis supplies the final proofs.
organization: University of Bonn; Google DeepMind; University of Manitoba

evidence.tested: Human-refined FunSearch outputs were used to derive improved adversarial lower bounds for standard heuristics; the page gives no details of the bin-packing test setup.
evidence.unknown: Not reported on the abstract page; the full paper is needed for the bin-packing evaluation details.
evidence.ai_role: LLM-based evolutionary search (FunSearch) supplied initial patterns, which human experts refined and extrapolated into constructions.
